context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “Lifted up as Moses lifted the serpent” preserves a distinct antecedent source unit within anticipation.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus compares the Son of Man being lifted up with Moses lifting the serpent and continues with statements about love, sending, and salvation.
observations.label: Lifted up as Moses lifted the serpent: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps jesus, moses, lifted up visible within its Crucifixion evidence.
observations.label: Lifted up as Moses lifted the serpent: action, promise, or consequence

payload.posture: Read John 3:14–17 as its own anticipation and stated approach crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The passage materially bears on the Crucifixion while leaving part of its motive, mechanism, or later significance unstated.
payload.title: Lifted up as Moses lifted the serpent
